items.source: When using pre-filters, you can either define filter() or use query derivation to define the pre-filter. Vector and distance parameters are considered once these are present. Vector search supports sorting and will consider Sort parameters.
items.translation: 在使用预过滤器时，您可以定义 filter() 或使用查询推导来定义预过滤器。当存在 Vector 和距离参数时，这些参数将被考虑。向量搜索支持排序，并将考虑 Sort 参数。

items.source: This over-request pattern is the recommended way to trade off latency and recall in your ANN searches, and we recommend tuning this parameter based on your specific dataset size and query requirements. Required if the query uses VectorSearchOperation.SearchType.ANN/VectorSearchOperation.SearchType.DEFAULT. Supports Value Expressions.
items.translation: 这种过度请求模式是推荐用于在 ANN 搜索中平衡延迟和召回率的方法，我们建议根据您的具体数据集大小和查询需求对该参数进行调优。当查询使用VectorSearchOperation.SearchType.ANN/VectorSearchOperation.SearchType.DEFAULT时，此参数为必填项。支持值表达式。

items.source: Vector search must define an index name using the indexName() attribute. The index must be created in the MongoDB Atlas cluster before executing the query. Any misspelling of the index name will result in returning no results.
items.translation: 向量搜索必须使用 indexName() 属性定义索引名称。该索引必须在执行查询之前于 MongoDB Atlas 集群中创建。如果索引名称拼写错误，将导致返回空结果。

items.source: Number of documents to return in the results. This value can't exceed the value of numCandidates() if you specify numCandidates(). Limit accepts Value Expressions. A Vector Search method cannot define both, limit() and a Limit parameter. Supports Value Expressions.
items.translation: 返回结果中的文档数量。如果您指定了 numCandidates()，则该值不能超过 numCandidates() 的值。Limit 支持值表达式。Vector Search 方法不能同时定义 limit() 和 Limit 参数。支持值表达式。

items.source: Annotation to declare Vector Search queries directly on repository methods. Vector Search queries are used to search for similar documents based on vector embeddings typically returning SearchResults and limited by either a Score (within) or a Range of scores (between).
items.translation: 用于在仓储方法上直接声明向量搜索查询的注解。向量搜索查询用于基于向量嵌入搜索相似文档，通常返回SearchResults，并通过分数限制（在某个Score范围内或在某个Range区间内）。

items.source: Number of nearest neighbors to use during the search. Value must be less than or equal to (<=) 10000. You can't specify a number less than the number of documents to return. We recommend that you specify a number at least 20 times higher than the number of documents to return to increase accuracy.
items.translation: 搜索期间使用的最近邻数量。该值必须小于或等于 (<=) 10000。您不能指定一个小于要返回的文档数量的数字。我们建议您将要返回的文档数量至少提高 20 倍，以提高准确性。
